description: Deletes every registrant of one webinar in a single step. Take it only when a list should really go, for example after a test run on a fresh campaign: "Nobody in there is real, clear the whole list." It needs the session, the webinar and a clear yes from you. Read the count first and say the number out loud, because this cannot be undone: the numbers fall to zero, the people disappear from the funnel, and emails already sent are not recalled. For one person there is a separate tool, and the list can be read out as a file before deleting. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: delete all registrants, empty the list, clear sign-ups, start over, test data

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that every registrant of this webinar may be deleted.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_delete_all_registrants
title: Delete every registrant of a webinar
